Dataset: Canadian Gridded Temperature and Precipitation Anomalies (CANGRD).
Publisher: Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC).
Source archive: ctvb_cangrd_temp_v2023_Gen3.tar.gz
Source URL: https://crd-data-donnees-rdc.ec.gc.ca/CDAS/products/EC_data/CANGRD/
Retrieved: 2026-11-09. Extraction is not an observation date.
Documentation: https://eccc-msc.github.io/open-data/msc-data/climate_cangrd/readme_cangrd_en/
Native coordinates: CANGRD_points_LL.txt, i=column and j=row, zero-based.
Native lattice: 125 columns by 95 rows, nominal 50-km polar stereographic grid.
Selection: latitude 46.5 to 50 degrees North; longitude -76 to -69 degrees.
Years: 1991 through 2020. Native period code 13 denotes annual values.
Source values are homogenized station observations interpolated by ECCC.
No further interpolation, reprojection or spatial resampling was applied here.

Columns:
  j, i: native integer row and column of the source grid.
  latitude, longitude: source geographic coordinates of the grid point, degrees.
  source_cell: row in the native coordinate file, retained for traceability.
  year: calendar year, an integer time index.
  tmin_anomaly_c: anomaly of annual mean daily minimum temperature, degrees C.
  tmax_anomaly_c: anomaly of annual mean daily maximum temperature, degrees C.
Reference period: 1961-1990. These values are anomalies, not absolute temperatures.

The selected footprint has 92 sites and is not a complete integer bounding box.
All 92 sites have both values for every selected year: 2760 site-years.
Values above 1e30 in absolute magnitude were treated as the documented native
missing-value sentinel. None occurs in this selected subset.
The source archive and coordinate-file SHA256 hashes are in
cangrd_quebec_SOURCE.json. The original 55-MB archive is not bundled.

The example is descriptive, with equal weights per selected site-year.
No area correction, stationarity, independence, mixing, trend-test calibration
or dependent-field confidence coverage is asserted.
